_readme: Permanent triage ledger for App/parse_prices.py's Cattelan-format review_flags mechanism (a block the parser declined to guess at rather than risk parsing wrong). Every product name that has EVER appeared in a review flag must have an entry here recording what was found. This is the tracked follow-up list that check_orphaned_flags.ts enforces -- a fresh flag on a product not listed here fails the build, forcing triage to happen instead of being silently forgotten (the exact bug found 2026-08-06: SAN MARCO/BLUEBELL/NAHUN/REGATA/LAVANDER were flagged but never followed up, and the app kept serving accessory-only data for them for an unknown period). Add a brand's product_name to CATTELAN_FORMAT_BRANDS in check_orphaned_flags.ts when a new brand (e.g. Bonaldo) starts using --format cattelan, so its flags get tracked from day one.

_status_meaning.real_gap: The flagged block was a genuine, entirely-missing price table. Fixed by hand-transcribing it into manual_additions.json (verified against the real page image, complete row set including any pre-existing correct rows since merge_manual_additions.py replaces the whole product).
_status_meaning.partial: The main price data was already correct; only a smaller secondary table (e.g. a Cavo aggiuntivo/Accessori row) was missing. Fixed the same way as real_gap, just a smaller row set.
_status_meaning.false_alarm: Checked the raw source text (and page image where the text alone was ambiguous) and confirmed prices.json already has the complete, correct data. The flag was about some other non-price element on the page, or a row count that looked suspicious but was correct. Nothing added to manual_additions.json.
_status_meaning.known_gap: Batch-categorized (not individually page-verified like real_gap/partial/false_alarm) into one of a small set of documented root-cause buckets -- used for Bonaldo's initial 197-product seeding on 2026-08-07, where per-product page-image verification the way Cattelan's SAN MARCO etc. got would have been a multi-session effort on its own. Every instance is a SAFE flag (parser returns zero rows / skips the ambiguous row rather than guessing -- never silently wrong). Does not require a manual_additions.json entry. A future dedicated cleanup pass should convert these to real_gap/partial/false_alarm per product as each bucket gets addressed (see bonaldo_index_and_structure memory for the per-bucket game plan).
